components.name: Slider
components.doc: A value or a range on a track. The thumb follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands past its limits, and settles on the step grid with the velocity of the release; pressing the track springs the nearest thumb there. A bubble with rolling digits rides the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard focused. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp, PageDown, Home, and End work as in a native range input.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible label. Range thumbs are named from it unless `thumbLabels` says otherwise.

members.name: value
members.doc: A number for one thumb, a pair for a range.

members.name: onValueCommit
members.doc: Runs once a drag is released or a key changes the value, for work too heavy for every step.

members.name: largeStep
members.doc: PageUp, PageDown, and Shift with an arrow move this far. Defaults to a tenth of the range.

members.name: marks
members.doc: Ticks on the track. A number draws a tick; a mark with a label also prints it under the track, and clicking it moves there.

members.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
members.doc: The closest two range thumbs may sit, in steps.

members.name: format
members.doc: Formats the readout, the bubble, and the spoken value.

members.name: showValue
members.doc: Show the value beside the label. The bubble over the thumb still appears while dragging or focused.

members.name: thumbLabels
members.doc: Accessible names for the two range thumbs.

members.name: start
members.doc: Content beside the track, such as an icon or a mute button.

members.name: name
members.doc: Submits the value with a form, one hidden input per thumb.
